mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 2.5% over three consecutive months signals a tightening cycle that raises discount rates and reduces present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.10) in periods where FEDFUNDS > 2.5% for three months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) exceeding 2% coincident with a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.5% signals weakening aggregate demand and recession risk, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or the combined signal fails to precede NBER-dated recessions in at least 70% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of more than 0.5% for four consecutive months indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which historically precedes negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days due to profit margin compression.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.10) during periods of four consecutive monthly INDPRO declines below -0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.4 percentage points in a single month, accompanied by a concurrent decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) of more than 50,000, signals labor market stress that typically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to earnings downgrades.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE change > +0.4pp AND PAYEMS change < -50000 in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) in triggered episodes, or the signal fails to precede at least 50% of subsequent earnings downgrades.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is held constant for four consecutive months at or below 0.25%, liquidity conditions remain highly accommodative, supporting risk asset valuations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS unchanged at or below 0.25% for 4 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.10) during periods of four consecutive months with FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.25% and unchanged.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in the housing starts index (HOUST) of at least 5% over three consecutive months signals a recovery in the housing market, which historically boosts consumer confidence and supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.10) in periods where HOUST rises by more than 5% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and a fall in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) of more than 100,000 in the same month, while consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) is below 1%, indicates a stagflation-like risk that typically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to deteriorating growth and profit expectations.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE change > +0.3pp AND PAYEMS change < -100000 AND CPIAUCSL < 100 (index value) in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.10) in triggered episodes, or the signal fails to precede at least 40% of subsequent negative GDP revisions.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly contraction in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of more than 0.3% for six consecutive months, regardless of monetary policy stance, signals broad-based supply chain weakness that typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to earnings compression and margin pressure.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.10) during periods of six consecutive monthly INDPRO declines below -0.3%.
